label: Realistic cinematic (live-action trailer)
summary: Photoreal live action like a big-budget game or film trailer: real people, motivated lighting, deep blacks, rich colour, dense coverage.
look: Photoreal live-action cinema shot on ARRI ALEXA 35 with vintage anamorphic-character prime lenses. Rich, saturated, true-to-life colour with deep clean blacks and controlled highlights; crisp fine detail and natural skin texture with pores. Lighting is motivated by real sources in the scene (sun, neon, practical lamps, screens, fire) with strong contrast between light and shadow. Shallow depth of field where the lens is long. Subtle fine film grain. No haze unless the scene itself is foggy or smoky. Never looks like CGI, a video game render or an illustration.
character_medium: one original character, a real person photographed as a casting reference, natural skin texture
sheet_backdrop: Seamless dark grey studio backdrop, even soft key light, neutral relaxed pose.
plate_medium: a real location photographed for a film, empty of people
vehicle_medium: a real original vehicle photographed in a studio
motion: Real-time live-action motion at 24 fps with natural motion blur. Real physical weight: cars grip and slide, water splashes, cloth moves, people shift their weight.
constraints: No CGI or video game look, no plastic skin, no illustration, no cartoon proportions, no readable text, no logos.
camera_language: 35 mm over-the-shoulder with a foreground shoulder
insert close-up of a hand or prop
lighting_menu: golden hour backlight with warm rim
harsh noon sun with hard shadows
neon pink and teal night light
single bare bulb interior, deep shadows
cool fluorescent interior with green cast
critic: faces stay the same person across shots (compare to the face sheet)
no plastic or waxy CGI skin
lighting matches the shot's LIGHTING line and the plate's time of day
hands, cars and water obey physics (drop morphing takes)
no readable text or logos appear
